Svasvāmiśaktyoḥ svarūpopalabdhihetuḥ saṃyogaḥ /II.23/
Sva-svāmi-śaktyoḥ svarūpa-upalabdhi-hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ /II.23/

 « La conjonction cause la compréhension de la nature propre aux deux énergies,
celle du bien possédé et celle du possesseur. »

Saṃyoga-svarūpa-abhidhitsayā–idaṃ sūtraṃ pravavṛte / Sva-svāmi-śaktyoḥ svarūpa-
upalabdhi-hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ / Puruṣaḥ svāmī dṛśyena svena darśana-arthaṃ saṃyuktaḥ /
Tasmāt saṃyogād dṛśyasya–upalabdhir yā sa bhogaḥ, yā tu draṣṭuḥ svarūpa-upalabdhiḥ,
so'pavargaḥ / Darśana-kārya-avasānaḥ saṃyoga iti darśanaṃ viyogasya kāraṇam uktam /
Darśanam adarśanasya pratidvandvi–ity adarśanaṃ saṃyoga-nimittam uktam / Na–atra
darśanaṃ mokṣa-kāra�
